callouts.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#1
callouts.title: 问题
callouts.body: 求下面含参数积分的极限:$$\lim_{n\to \infty} \int_{[0,1]^n}n\left(\frac{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i^2}{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\,dx_{1}\cdots dx_n$$

classification_result.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#1

if_problem.statement_en: Find the limit of the following parameter-dependent integral: $$\lim_{n\to \infty} \int_{[0,1]^n}n\left(\frac{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i^2}{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\,dx_{1}\cdots dx_n$$
key_techniques: rewrite the integral as an expectation
asymptotic expansion of a ratio of sample means
Taylor expansion around the population means
prerequisites: expectation and integration over product spaces

callouts.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#2
callouts.title: 概率版本的等价问题
callouts.body:
在概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上有一列独立且符合$U(0,1)$的随机变量$X_1,...,X_n,...$,求期望的极限:
$$E \left [n\left(\frac{\overline{Y_n}}{\overline{X_n}}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\right]$$其中$\overline{Y_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i^2}{n}$，以及$\overline{X_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i}{n}$

classification_result.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#2

if_problem.statement_en: On a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$, let $X_1,\dots,X_n,\dots$ be independent random variables with distribution $U(0,1)$. Find the limit of the expectation $$E \left [n\left(\frac{\overline{Y_n}}{\overline{X_n}}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\right],$$ where $\overline{Y_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i^2}{n}$ and $\overline{X_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i}{n}$.
key_techniques: analyze the ratio of sample means
use asymptotic expansion near the mean

if_strategy_template.summary_en: When a quantity involves a smooth function of sample averages, expand the function around the limiting mean point. This reduces the expectation to combinations of lower-order moments such as variances and covariances.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a statistic can be written as $f(\overline{X}_n,\overline{Y}_n)$ and the sample averages concentrate near deterministic limits where $f$ is smooth.

callouts.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#4
callouts.title: 关于期望，方差，协方差的基本定义和运算
callouts.body:
如果$X_1,...,X_n$以及$Y_1,...,Y_n$是概率空间当中两列独立同分布的随机变量，并且定义$\overline{Y_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} Y_i}{n}$，以及$\overline{X_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i}{n}$，那么: 
1. $$E(\overline{X_n}-E(X_1))=0$$
2. 
$$E\left[\left(\overline{X_n}-E(X_1)\right)^2\right]=\frac{V(X_1)}{n}$$
3. 
$$\begin{aligned}E\left[\left(\overline{X_n}-E(X_1)\right)\left(\overline{Y_n}-E(Y_1)\right)\right]&=\text{Cov}(\overline{X_n},\overline{Y_n})\\&=E(\overline{X_n}\,\overline{Y_n})-E(\overline{X_n})E(\overline{Y_n})\end{aligned}$$

callouts.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#6
callouts.title: Hoeffding不等式
callouts.body: 假设概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上的随机变量$X_n$是独立同分布的，并且$X_n(\omega)\in [a,b]$对任意正整数n成立，$\overline{X}_n$是前n个随机变量的算术平均值，$\mu$是这列随机变量的均值，那么对于任意$\varepsilon>0$都有:$$P\left(|\overline{X}_n-\mu|\geq \varepsilon \right)\leq 2\exp\left(-\frac{2n\varepsilon^2}{(b-a)^2}\right)$$

classification_result.id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#6

if_problem.statement_en: Assume that the random variables $X_n$ on a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$ are independent and identically distributed, and that $X_n(\omega)\in [a,b]$ for every positive integer $n$. Let $\overline{X}_n$ be the arithmetic mean of the first $n$ random variables, and let $\mu$ be their common mean. Then for every $\varepsilon>0$, $$P\left(|\overline{X}_n-\mu|\geq \varepsilon \right)\leq 2\exp\left(-\frac{2n\varepsilon^2}{(b-a)^2}\right).$$
key_techniques: exponential tail bound for bounded independent variables
